title: Munchkin TTRPG, DnD Movie Sequel Struggles, Underdark UA Part 2 – TTRPG News 9/10/2026
summary: Card game Munchkin comes to TTRPG, word on the DnD movie’s potential sequel, a new Unearthed Arcana with Underdark theming, and Steve Jackson makes a career move.
body_markdown:
Another week down, another round of news from the tabletop RPG world! Here are this week’s biggest happenings in the industry, delivered in a few quick headlines so you can get back to fireballing every room.


This week: Card game *Munchkin* comes to TTRPG, word on the DnD movie’s potential sequel, a new Unearthed Arcana with Underdark theming, and Steve Jackson makes a career move.


### **Munchkin 5e Is Now A Thing**


The card game ***Munchkin*** is getting a TTRPG spinoff, and it’s powered by **5.5e** . *Munchkin* maker **Steve Jackson Games** is teaming up with Lynnvander Studios to deliver ***Munchkin 5.5E RPG*** . There’s a[pre-launch page on BackerKit](https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/lynnvander-studios/munchkin-5-5e-rpg/pre-launch?) that showcases the iconic *Munchkin* art style, subclasses like the **Oath of Killjoy Paladin** , and lots and lots of bonus loot like **The Deck of Ridiculous Things** . The crossover itself consists of two books: ***Munchkin 5.5e Ye Olde Rulebook*** with rules and player content compatible with DnD 5.5e, and **The Deadliest Dungeon.** Crowdfunding will go live in October.


### **Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves Sequel Is Written, But Needs A Studio**


The **DnD movie** *Honor Among Thieves* has a sequel ready, but **Hasbro** needs a studio partner to bring it to life. EN world[reports](https://www.enworld.org/threads/dungeons-dragons-honor-among-thieves-sequel-script-finished-looking-for-studio.720557/) , as per the Discourse Podcast, that the writer/director team behind the movie have a sequel script written. *Honor Among Thieves* had a $150 million budget and made $208 million at the global box office, which is considered a disappointment even if it’s not a bomb. Writers/directors John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein attributed the performance to several factors like being against the ***uper Mario Bros. Movie*** and the **OGL** debacle just having happened. The movie was praised by critics and fans alike, but the underwhelming box office makes it a tough sell to studios.


### **DnD Unearthed Arcana Goes Back To The Underdark**


The DnD Team sent out another[batch of playtest player options](https://www.dndbeyond.com/posts/2243-designer-insights-from-unearthed-arcana-underdark#drider) themed around the **Underdark** . The new species lean more into the fantastical, letting you be a **Myconid, Kuo-Toa, Deep Imaskari, Illithidkin, and even a Drider** . Three new subclasses include a Dex-based **Freedom Cleric** , radiation-based **Faerzress Sorcerer** , and the **5.5e Circle of Spore Druid** . The user survey releases on **September 17** for official feedback, but for now it seems a lot of fans enjoy the flavor but are divided on the Sorcerer subclass.


### **Steve Jackson No Longer CEO Of Steve Jackson Games**


Steve Jackson has stepped down as CEO of his eponymous company to focus more on game design. Jackson was serving in the role temporarily after the CEO resigned last year. His replacement will be Sabrina Gonzalez,[reports ICv2](https://icv2.com/articles/news/view/63353/people-move-steve-jackson-steps-down-ceo-steve-jackson-games) , a company regular since 2013.


‍


That’s all for this week! Thanks for reading, and may your dice be kind.
